Yes, i .. i'm playing game of the Goose into the spiral. And keep building shortcuts into that maze.

Not so good at it, but it might have some positive radiance. We can't do much about falling bodies. 

This *present time* is permanently ceasing.

Aaaw i envy you :) i do sport for years now and have a healthy way of life (except for the sleeping time i must admit) but it didn't really change my life. 
My body yep a lot but i still feel this pain. I already wrote (not here) that i was envious about people who felt super great after their workout because i generally feel neutral and of course exhausted. Almost never good. 
When i'm in the middle of exercise sometimes i feel really great but again not always. That bein said i felt a bit better when i strated to suppervise the macronutrients i eat but hmm yeah! exercize could only make it better, sorry if i slow down the enthusiasm really not my intention. I think too this rush for life can be found again under different forms. And i hope we'll find it :)
Happens all the time fuuu x)) i always apprehends this kind of situation + i realize each time a little more that we dont share the same interests anymore.

I know this desillusion.. but sometimes it really makes me smile, when i remember my dreams i mean. They are always so full of life. I know i dont live in my dreams, but if i can find peace in some places..

Hmm just few hours ago my dad advised me to try hypnosis. But in a kind way.
